caption: A cat trots along a night street beneath a row of streetlamps, brightening as it passes under each lamp and fading in the dark stretches between.

sa.check: A cat trots along a street beneath a row of streetlamps.
It brightens as it passes under each lamp.
It fades in the dark stretches between.

pc.expect: The cat is brightest directly under each lamp and dimmest midway between, repeating for each lamp.
pc.fail: It is evenly lit along the street; or brightest between lamps; or dark under a lamp.

pc.expect: The brightening and fading alternate with the lamps.
pc.fail: It stays bright; or stays dark; or flickers unrelated to position.

pc.expect: Its shadow points away from the nearest lamp and swaps sides as it passes beneath.
pc.fail: The shadow points toward the lamp; or stays on one side; or there is none.

pc.expect: The lamps stay lit and still.
pc.fail: A lamp goes out; or moves; or flickers.
It splits; or turns into another animal; or a second cat appears.

pc.expect: The cat's coat and the street stay the same.
pc.fail: The coat changes colour rather than brightness; or the street rearranges; or the lamps change.

note: The cat is self-driven; only the light on it is judged. Illumination: the on/off causality of electric lights belongs to Electricity; here only where the light goes once it exists is judged.
